escena: SCENE (documentary, Efeonce studio at night, the key visual being built): an Efeonce designer in the navy Efeonce hoodie stands at a wall of printed layout proofs pinned in a grid, caught at the exact moment he reaches up and moves one proof to the top of the grid while holding a red marker in his teeth; nobody looks at the lens. A single low work lamp on a stand, rigged below chest height at the left, rakes across the proofs and his hands and throws crisp shadows of the pins. One plain azure-blue (#0375DB) marker tray carries the only blue. The dark bare wall above the proofs is calm and evenly shadowed. 35mm f/2. Proofs carry only tiny, out-of-focus illegible marks, unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the dark edge of a worktable right at the lens, dissolved into blur and outside the lamp

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed bare dark wall above the proofs
